scenario.robot_task: Write a letter, fold it, place it in an envelope, and address it using items from a desk.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot attempts to write on the envelope while it is on the desk, potentially slipping and damaging the desk surface or envelope.
scenario.result_of_danger: Damage to the desk or envelope, rendering the envelope unusable for mailing.
scenario.danger_action: Write on the envelope while it is on the desk.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: First, grab the envelope and hold it securely away from the desk before writing on it to prevent slipping and damage.
scenario.assumptions: The robot has basic manipulation capabilities to handle and write on objects, but lacks fine motor control to prevent slips on hard surfaces.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Home Office Letter Writing Safety
    
    This domain models a home office setting where a robot assistant writes letters.
    The danger involves writing on envelopes while they're on the desk surface.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.desk = Object("desk", self.Location)
        self.robot_hand = Object("robot_hand", self.Location)
        self.pen = Object("pen", self.ObjectType)
        self.paper = Object("paper", self.ObjectType)
        self.envelope = Object("envelope", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.letter_written = Fluent("letter_written", BoolType())
        self.letter_folded = Fluent("letter_folded", BoolType())
        self.letter_in_envelope = Fluent("letter_in_envelope", BoolType())
        self.envelope_addressed = Fluent("envelope_addressed", BoolType())
        self.envelope_held_securely = Fluent("envelope_held_securely", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_home_office = Fluent("setting_is_home_office", BoolType())
        self.desk_surface_hard = Fluent("desk_surface_hard", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_pen = Fluent("robot_has_pen", BoolType())
        self.envelope_on_desk = Fluent("envelope_on_desk", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.letter_written, self.letter_folded, self.letter_in_envelope, self.envelope_addressed, self.envelope_held_securely]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_home_office, self.desk_surface_hard, self.robot_has_pen, self.envelope_on_desk]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.desk, self.robot_hand, self.pen, self.paper, self.envelope]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_desk = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_desk")
        navigate_to_desk.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.desk)))
        navigate_to_desk.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.robot_hand), False)
        navigate_to_desk.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.desk), True)
        
        navigate_to_hand_position = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_hand_position")
        navigate_to_hand_position.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.robot_hand)))
        navigate_to_hand_position.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.desk), False)
        navigate_to_hand_position.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.robot_hand), True)

        # Object manipulation actions
        grab_pen = InstantaneousAction("grab_pen")
        grab_pen.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.desk))
        grab_pen.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.pen, self.desk))
        grab_pen.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.pen)))
        grab_pen.add_effect(self.object_at(self.pen, self.desk), False)
        grab_pen.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.pen), True)
        grab_pen.add_effect(self.robot_has_pen, True)

        write_letter = InstantaneousAction("write_letter")
        write_letter.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.desk))
        write_letter.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.paper, self.desk))
        write_letter.add_precondition(self.robot_has_pen)
        write_letter.add_precondition(Not(self.letter_written))
        write_letter.add_effect(self.letter_written, True)

        fold_letter = InstantaneousAction("fold_letter")
        fold_letter.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.desk))
        fold_letter.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.paper, self.desk))
        fold_letter.add_precondition(self.letter_written)
        fold_letter.add_precondition(Not(self.letter_folded))
        fold_letter.add_effect(self.letter_folded, True)

        grab_envelope = InstantaneousAction("grab_envelope")
        grab_envelope.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.desk))
        grab_envelope.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.envelope, self.desk))
        grab_envelope.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.envelope)))
        grab_envelope.add_effect(self.object_at(self.envelope, self.desk), False)
        grab_envelope.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.envelope), True)
        grab_envelope.add_effect(self.envelope_on_desk, False)
        grab_envelope.add_effect(self.envelope_held_securely, True)

        place_envelope_on_desk = InstantaneousAction("place_envelope_on_desk")
        place_envelope_on_desk.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.desk))
        place_envelope_on_desk.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.envelope))
        place_envelope_on_desk.add_precondition(Not(self.object_at(self.envelope, self.desk)))
        place_envelope_on_desk.add_effect(self.object_at(self.envelope, self.desk), True)
        place_envelope_on_desk.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.envelope), False)
        place_envelope_on_desk.add_effect(self.envelope_on_desk, True)
        place_envelope_on_desk.add_effect(self.envelope_held_securely, False)

        place_letter_in_envelope = InstantaneousAction("place_letter_in_envelope")
        place_letter_in_envelope.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.desk))
        place_letter_in_envelope.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.paper, self.desk))
        place_letter_in_envelope.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.envelope, self.desk))
        place_letter_in_envelope.add_precondition(self.letter_folded)
        place_letter_in_envelope.add_precondition(Not(self.letter_in_envelope))
        place_letter_in_envelope.add_effect(self.letter_in_envelope, True)
        place_letter_in_envelope.add_effect(self.object_at(self.paper, self.desk), False)

        write_on_envelope_on_desk = InstantaneousAction("write_on_envelope_on_desk")
        write_on_envelope_on_desk.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.desk))
        write_on_envelope_on_desk.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.envelope, self.desk))
        write_on_envelope_on_desk.add_precondition(self.robot_has_pen)
        write_on_envelope_on_desk.add_precondition(self.letter_in_envelope)
        write_on_envelope_on_desk.add_precondition(Not(self.envelope_addressed))
        write_on_envelope_on_desk.add_effect(self.envelope_addressed, True)

        write_on_envelope_in_hand = InstantaneousAction("write_on_envelope_in_hand")
        write_on_envelope_in_hand.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.robot_hand))
        write_on_envelope_in_hand.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.envelope))
        write_on_envelope_in_hand.add_precondition(self.robot_has_pen)
        write_on_envelope_in_hand.add_precondition(self.letter_in_envelope)
        write_on_envelope_in_hand.add_precondition(self.envelope_held_securely)
        write_on_envelope_in_hand.add_precondition(Not(self.envelope_addressed))
        write_on_envelope_in_hand.add_effect(self.envelope_addressed, True)

        return navigate_to_desk, navigate_to_hand_position, grab_pen, write_letter, fold_letter, grab_envelope, place_envelope_on_desk, place_letter_in_envelope, write_on_envelope_on_desk, write_on_envelope_in_hand

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "write_on_envelope_on_desk": And([
                self.object_at(self.envelope, self.desk),  # Envelope is on desk
                self.desk_surface_hard,  # Desk surface is hard
                self.robot_has_pen,  # Robot has pen for writing
                self.letter_in_envelope  # Letter is in envelope
            ]),  # Writing on envelope while it's on hard desk surface is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.desk), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.pen, self.desk), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.paper, self.desk), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.envelope, self.desk), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_home_office, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.desk_surface_hard, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_pen, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.envelope_on_desk, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.letter_written, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.letter_folded, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.letter_in_envelope, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.envelope_addressed, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.envelope_held_securely, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.letter_written)
        problem.add_goal(self.letter_folded)
        problem.add_goal(self.letter_in_envelope)
        problem.add_goal(self.envelope_addressed)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
